contents.match: Match each coffee drink to what goes into it.
contents.reverse: Which coffee drink is made like this: {value}?

rows.label: Espresso
rows.contents: Finely ground beans and hot water forced through under pressure
rows.description: strong type of coffee made using hot water under pressure
rows.hook: is the small, intense shot that forms the base of most café menu drinks

rows.label: Mocha
rows.description: chocolate-flavored variant of a caffè latte
rows.hook: takes its name from a Yemeni port city that was central to the early bean trade

rows.label: Cortado
rows.contents: Espresso cut with about the same amount of warm milk
rows.description: beverage consisting of espresso mixed with a roughly equal amount of warm milk to reduce the acidity
rows.hook: has a Spanish name meaning "cut", since its strong base is softened with a little dairy

rows.label: Affogato
rows.contents: Vanilla ice cream or gelato drowned in hot espresso
rows.hook: is an Italian dessert made by pouring a fresh shot over a frozen scoop

rows.label: Americano
rows.contents: Espresso topped up with hot water
rows.description: type of coffee drink prepared by diluting an espresso with hot water, giving it a similar strength to, but different flavor from, traditionally brewed coffee
rows.hook: is a shot stretched into a long, lighter black drink

rows.label: Cappuccino
rows.contents: Espresso, steamed milk and milk foam
rows.hook: is named for the color of the robes worn by a religious order of friars

rows.label: Flat white
rows.hook: is a drink that both Australia and New Zealand claim to have invented

rows.label: Latte
rows.hook: is the mellow Italian café order traditionally served in a tall glass

rows.label: Pumpkin spice latte
rows.contents: Espresso, steamed milk and pumpkin-spice syrup
rows.hook: is the fall seasonal favorite launched by Starbucks and widely imitated since

rows.label: Cold brew
rows.contents: Coarse grounds steeped in cold water for many hours
rows.hook: is made by soaking beans for half a day or more instead of using heat

rows.label: Turkish coffee
rows.description: coffee brewing method originating from Turkey
rows.hook: is prepared unfiltered in a small long-handled pot called a cezve

rows.label: Ristretto
rows.contents: Espresso pulled short with less water
